reviews.text: Excellent, Easy to Use, Tiny Typeface. Possibly my favorite app for shopping. Versatile, customizable, incredibly intuitive. My only complaint, and it’s admittedly personal, is that the typeface cannot be increased. As someone who’s eyes are not what they once were, this can be a bit frustrating for an app that is primarily text based. But, on the whole, it’s a big thumbs up from me. Used it happily for a few years now.

This app is useless if you are colorblind. My wife and I have been searching for a decent shared shopping list for a while. Most list apps have terrible privacy options and share a lot of your private data. 

When we found this app it seemed promising. It has reasonable privacy policies and seems easy enough to use, except for one thing. 

The app is centered around using color coded tags to group food items. This probably works fine for most people but I am red-green colorblind and using color as the primary grouping mechanism does not work for me.

Grocery shopping app extraordinaire. I have been using the Pro version for Apple devices of this app for 8+ years. It allows me to make lists for all the different places I shop, customize items and place them in color-coded categories and easily cross them off the list while still keeping them visible. You can also add the qty of each item, or in my case, use that feature to add the current sale $ or some other factor like a coupon or rebate. Another great feature is that it syncs across multiple devices. So, I can create a list in the app on my iPad and then launch it on my phone when I am ready to shop. Sharing the list with other family members either by then having the app or exporting it to them via text message in a bonus option. I don’t imaging ever going back to a paper list that I could misplace or lose while shopping. 

My one complaint that I have mentioned to the developer in the past is that when you create a brand new list and go to enter a title (replacing the default Shopping List title), if you are not fast enough or the title you enter is long and takes more than 10 seconds, what you entered disappears and is replaced again with Shopping List. It only does this on the first attempt of the new list, but it is annoying. I would like to see this glitch fixed as it has been ongoing for years.

It would be nice to have the Amount field display darker. Right now, the field is lighter than the item.
A part of my day. I think of something I need - boom! On the list it goes! Love this app!

This is a great app!. The below review was written long long ago and the app has changed and has gotten so much better! Deleting or editing an item is done by swiping left now and clearing your shopped items is no longer frustrating. To get excellent instructions, go to the settings "gear" and look for "help." 5 Stars. I LOVE Buy Me A Pie!

[Review from more than 4 years ago - maybe 2015?]
For those who think there's no way to delete or edit the master list, tap the "i" to the left of "Shopping List" and then tap the "?" to the right of "Account" for instructions. Easy to use once you figure it out. It keeps me from forgetting items on the list since the list keeps getting shorter and shorter as I mark things off. It's nice that there are extra colors to use to create extra categories (purple and dark blue). I love this app so much! Version 3.2 scared me at first because the colors and font changed (yellow changed to pink for paper goods, chemicals, and health & beauty), but there are some improvements the pop up list returns 5 lines of items with more items on a line and a sharper font, the list will now work in either portrait or landscape, and in portrait, 17 items will appear on the page (don't know whether this is more or less than before) but items seem more separated so as not to accidentally remove them from the list. [fixed in 2.9.1 - now search returns 3 lines, not as good as original version, but acceptable. I noticed that a search returns items in the order in which they were added to the list] Sad. I lowered my rating from 5 to 4 because version 2.9 added a bug. It used to be that putting in a few letters of an item would bring up all of the items that contained those letters, now it brings up only items that will fit on one line. As a result, I think I need to create a new item that is already in the list. It doesn't even show up as I continue to type unless I type the words in the correct order. For example, "beans" will (in my list) return Beans, Kidney Beans, and Canned Green Beans. It won't return "Chili Beans" unless I type "Chili." I still love this app! [fixed in 2.8 hooray!] Only annoyance is that when the list is long and I accidentally touch an item and delete it, I have to pull the list upward to see the bottom of the list and then physically put the item back on when the list is short enough, I can just touch the crossed out item to put it back on the list, but when the list is long, you can't touch the item. When you do look at the bottom of the list to see what you accidentally deleted and then you let go of it, all of the deleted items disappear. Still, I love the app!
Grocery list. Best grocery list I’ve ever used can have 3 different store lists

Save me the money!!!. I have to say, such a simple app is priceless to me. For years when going on my grocery runs, I cannot focus on what I need and wander the aisles trying to incorporate ingredients for meals I would like to prepare for the week with the items I need to replenish. I spend way too much time and end up with things I don’t need. I said to myself, make a list dummy. Great, but half the times I leave it in the car or at the house. Until, your app which was recommended to me by a co- worker. Now, as needed, I can add to list at home and always have with me at the store since my phone is always on hand. I save money and time. Thank you, thank you, thank you :>)
Grocery App. I love this app. I am able to add to my grocery list as I think of things I’m needing.
Not synking. The program does not work as well as it could. It would be great if you could have the list that is pending in alphabetical order.

Easy to use and Helpful. The app is simple and good for making quick shopping lists. I like how you can type in the items and choose colors to color code items. While shopping, you can click the item and it will disappear to the bottom like you checked it off the list. These items can also be tapped on to put it back onto the shopping list. Once you input items, the app also remembers your items so you don’t double anything or have to retype. This app meets my needs for the most part. I still need to figure out how to change the previous colors for items. But will try that later.

My shopping list. I use this app frequently. I always have my phone with me. Using this instead of a written list allows me to add to it at any time. When I was using a handwritten list, I sometimes misplaced it, forgot it, or couldn’t read my writing. The app is easier. You can add multiple stores, in case one doesn’t have what you need.
Keeping my life in sync!. I really love this app for keeping my shopping lists in sync. I have one for each of the stores i go to regularly and updating it each time is super easy.
reviews.theme: совместные списки и синхронизация с семьёй

reviews.text:
The List App For People Who Hate Making Lists. The best part about Buy Me
a Pie is that it keeps your inactive list items below the active field so you don’t have to re-type them in the next time you go shopping.
Shopping lists. Love it!! I can have a list for each store. No more forgetting my list at the house.
Buy Me A Pie Review. Great app to make your shopping easier. This includes all types of shopping from grocery and hardware stores to sporting goods stores. Perfect for shortening your shopping time.

Can’t See Titles Of Lists. Annoying that only white space shows where the title of a list should be. This is in the “my lists“ screen. What is wrong? I have the Pro Version. Also, I tried to submit a ticket for this on the website but I get a message telling me I am not authorized to use the site.
Cut Grocery Trips. The ability to write in my I-Phone what I need to purchase makes it a lot easier and avoids having to waste gasoline to the grocery store.

Buy me a pie!! Should have been 5 start except for. My husband and I have been using this app for several years. Perfectly… and I’ve shared it with so many friends! This year in an update the ability to edit an entry (if spelled wrong) is gone??? Or is it hiding in plain sight? Where did it go? 
That is my only complaint. Otherwise it would def be 5 stars!!
Great APP. I’ve used this app for years. Easy to use and a great way to keep track of items to buy when shopping.
Great App. This app is so handy to have on my phone. I can keep a couple of lists running at the same time. It’s definitely made my shopping life easier.
Free Version barely useful. Not enough features. Few controls and it intuitive

Buy me a pie. There may be other grocery apps but this one is great. I have been using for years. It’s easy to use why would anyone need one more complicated. Perfect. Please don’t change it to make it better, usually the changes are not better when supposedly new improved is not better. A grocery list does not have to be difficult. This one even puts item in order. I love it!!!!!
